papers.title: Forecasting Rent vs. Buy Housing Costs Using Metro-Level Zillow Data
papers.venue: Digital Commons - East Tennessee State University (East Tennessee State University)
papers.summary_zh: 本文属于「房地产金融」领域，主题为：Forecasting Rent vs. Buy Housing Costs Using Metro-Level Zillow Data。涉及关键词：Metropolitan area、Econometrics、Economics。原文未提供摘要，建议通过 DOI 链接查看全文以了解具体研究方法与结论。

papers.title: Causal Diffusion Models for Counterfactual Outcome Distributions in Longitudinal Data
papers.abstract: Predicting counterfactual outcomes in longitudinal data, where sequential treatment decisions heavily depend on evolving patient states, is critical yet notoriously challenging due to complex time-dependent confounding and inadequate uncertainty quantification in existing methods. We introduce the Causal Diffusion Model (CDM), the first denoising diffusion probabilistic approach explicitly designed to generate full probabilistic distributions of counterfactual outcomes under sequential interventions. CDM employs a novel residual denoising architecture with relational self-attention, capturing intricate temporal dependencies and multimodal outcome trajectories without requiring explicit adjustments (e.g., inverse-probability weighting or adversarial balancing) for confounding. In rigorous evaluation on a pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic tumor-growth simulator widely adopted in prior work, CDM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art longitudinal causal inference methods, achieving a 15-30% relative improvement in distributional accuracy (1-Wasserstein distance) while maintaining competitive or superior point-estimate accuracy (RMSE) under high-confounding regimes. By unifying uncertainty quantification and robust counterfactual prediction in complex, sequentially confounded settings, without tailored deconfounding, CDM offers a flexible, high-impact tool for decision support in medicine, policy evaluation, and other longitudinal domains.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在纵向数据中预测反事实结果至关重要，因为连续的治疗决策在很大程度上取决于患者状态的变化。然而，由于复杂的时变混杂因素以及现有方法中不确定性量化不足，这一任务极具挑战性。我们提出了因果扩散模型（CDM），这是首个专门为在连续干预下生成反事实结果的完整概率分布而设计的去噪扩散概率方法。CDM采用了一种新颖的残差去噪架构，并结合了关系自注意力机制，能够捕捉复杂的时间依赖性和多模态结果轨迹，而无需对混杂因素进行显式调整（例如逆概率加权或对抗性平衡）。在针对先前研究中广泛使用的药代动力学-药效学肿瘤生长模拟器的严格评估中，CDM的表现始终优于现有的纵向因果推断方法：在分布准确性（1-瓦瑟斯坦距离）方面实现了15-30%的相对提升，同时在高混杂环境下仍保持了具有竞争力的或更优的点估计准确性（均方根误差）。通过在不进行专门混杂因素处理的情况下，统一不确定性量化和稳健的反事实预测能力，CDM为医学决策支持、政策评估及其他纵向研究领域提供了一个灵活且影响广泛的工具。。研究方法：因果推断。

papers.title: Investigating the Impacts of Exchange Rate and Inflation on Exports: A Double Threat or Opportunity for Turkiye?
papers.abstract: This study analyzes the impacts of exchange rate and inflation on exports in Turkiye. Annual data for the period 1995-2023 were used in the analysis. The Johansen cointegration analysis and Dynamic Least Squares (DOLS) method were employed in the study. Identifying the cointegration relationship enabled the estimation of the long-run coefficients. The results show that an increase in the real effective exchange rate (appreciation of the Turkish lira) and inflation reduce exports with coefficients of -0.185 and -0.125, respectively. Foreign direct investment and imports, added to the study as control variables, have a positive impact on exports with coefficients of 0.117 and 0.849, respectively. These findings indicate that exchange rate stability and inflation control are priorities for improving foreign trade performance. Furthermore, policies that increase foreign direct investment and strategically manage imports complement this process.
papers.summary_zh: 【货币政策与宏观经济】本研究分析了汇率和通货膨胀对土耳其出口的影响。分析使用了1995年至2023年的年度数据，并采用了Johansen协整分析和动态最小二乘法（DOLS）进行研究方法。通过识别协整关系，得以估计出长期影响系数。研究结果表明，实际有效汇率的上升（土耳其里拉的升值）和通货膨胀都会抑制出口，其影响系数分别为-0.185和-0.125。作为控制变量加入的研究因素中，外国直接投资和进口对出口具有促进作用，其影响系数分别为0.117和0.849。这些发现表明，保持汇率稳定和控制通货膨胀是提升外贸表现的优先事项；此外，鼓励外国直接投资和战略性管理进口的政策能够进一步促进这一进程。。研究方法：协整分析。

papers.title: Analysis of Purchase Decisions for MSME-Processed Functional Food Products in the Jabodetabek Region: A Model Testing of the Effects of Functional Value, Brand Image, Electronic Word of Mouth, and Local Wisdom-Based Marketing
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: The Influence of Functional Value, Brand Image, Electronic Word of Mouth, and Local Wisdom-Based Marketing on Purchase Decisions for MSME Functional Food Products in the Jabodetabek Region. This study was motivated by the increasing competition among MSME functional food products in urban areas, which necessitates marketing strategies grounded in rational, digital, and cultural value dimensions. The research aims to analyze the effects of functional value, brand image, electronic word of mouth communication, and Local Wisdom-Based Marketing on consumers’ purchase decisions. An explanatory quantitative approach was employed, utilizing a survey of 240 consumers of MSME functional food products in the Jabodetabek region selected through purposive sampling. The data were analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling based on Partial Least Squares. The findings indicate that all variables exert a positive and significant influence on purchase decisions, with electronic word of mouth emerging as the most dominant variable, followed by Local Wisdom-Based Marketing, brand image, and functional value. These results affirm that purchase decisions are shaped by a combination of rational, social, symbolic, and cultural stimuli processed through consumers’ cognitive and affective evaluations. This study contributes to the development of MSME marketing strategies through the integration of functional, digital, and local cultural values.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本研究旨在分析功能性价值、品牌形象、电子口碑及基于地方智慧的营销对雅加达大都会区MSME功能性食品产品购买决策的具体影响。

🔬 研究方法：研究采用解释性定量方法，通过对雅加达大都会区240名消费者的问卷调查，并利用基于偏最小二乘法的结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行数据分析。

📊 核心发现：研究发现所有变量均对购买决策产生积极且显著的影响，其中电子口碑的影响力最为显著，其次是基于地方智慧的营销、品牌形象和功能性价值。

💡 应用价值：该研究通过整合功能性、数字

papers.title: The Empathy Channel in Fertility -- by Sebastian Galiani, Raul A. Sosa
papers.abstract: Being around babies makes people want babies. We formalize this observation as the empathy channel: exposure to infants in the social environment activates neurobiological mechanisms that increase the desire for parenthood. As children become scarcer, this affective stimulus weakens, further eroding the motivation to have children. We embed the mechanism in a two-group overlapping-generations quantity-quality model. The empathy channel generates a positive externality, since each birth raises others’ desire for children, making the decentralized equilibrium inefficient. We characterize the optimal per-child subsidy and show that the first-order Pigouvian rate substantially overshoots the general-equilibrium optimum. The optimal targeting rule follows a Ramsey-like logic, directing the subsidy at the group with the most externality per fiscal dollar, not the group with the largest externality per child. The calibrated model suggests that the empathy channel can account for 3–33% of the fertility decline, with 13.4% at the baseline. At this baseline, the Pigouvian overshoot is 23–32% and the optimal subsidy raises welfare by 0.22% in consumption-equivalent terms.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】与婴儿接触会让人产生想要孩子的愿望。我们将这一现象称为“同理心机制”：在社会环境中接触婴儿会激活某些神经生物学机制，从而增强人们成为父母的意愿。然而，随着儿童数量的减少，这种情感刺激逐渐减弱，进一步削弱了人们生育的动机。我们将这一机制纳入一个包含两组人群、且世代重叠的数量-质量模型中进行分析。同理心机制会产生正外部性，因为每个新生儿的诞生都会提升其他人对孩子的需求，从而导致分散决策下的均衡效率低下。我们研究了最优的儿童补贴政策，并发现一阶庇古税（Pigouvian tax）的税率会大幅超过一般均衡下的最优水平。最优的补贴分配规则遵循类似拉姆齐（Ramsey）的逻辑，即将补贴发放给每单位财政支出所产生的外部性最大的群体，而非每个孩子所带来外部性最大的群体。根据模型估算，同理心机制可以解释3%至33%的生育率下降现象；在基准情景下，这一比例约为13.4%。在这一基准情况下，庇古税的过度征收会导致福利损失23%至32%，而最优补贴政策则能使福利水平提高0.22%（以消费等值单位衡量）。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Profit Regulation and Strategic Transfer Pricing by Vertically Integrated Firms: Evidence from Health Care -- by Pragya Kakani, Eric Yde, Genevieve P. Kanter, Richard G. Frank, Amelia M. Bond
papers.abstract: We provide evidence of strategic transfer pricing by vertically integrated health care firms in response to insurer profit regulations. Insurers increased prices at vertically integrated pharmacies by 9.5% following the introduction of caps on insurer profits in Medicare Part D. We detect larger price increases by insurers that were at greatest risk of exceeding the allowable profit level. More than one-fifth of these higher prices were borne by the federal government. Our analysis illustrates that vertically integrated firms can evade profit regulation by “tunneling” profits to unregulated subsidiaries, undermining regulatory intent and increasing health care spending.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】我们提供了证据，证明垂直整合的医疗保健企业在面对保险公司利润监管时采用了战略性转让定价策略。在医疗保险D部分（Medicare Part D）实施利润上限规定后，保险公司将其旗下药店的价格提高了9.5%。我们发现，那些最有可能超出允许利润水平的保险公司提高了更高的价格。这些价格上涨带来的成本中，有超过五分之一由联邦政府承担。我们的分析表明，垂直整合的企业可以通过将利润“转移”至不受监管的子公司来规避利润监管，从而削弱监管效果，并增加医疗保健支出。。

papers.title: Forecasting Oil Prices Across the Distribution: A Quantile VAR Approach
papers.abstract: We develop a Quantile Bayesian Vector Autoregression (QBVAR) to forecast real oil prices across different quantiles of the conditional distribution. The model allows predictor effects to vary across quantiles, capturing asymmetries that standard mean-focused approaches miss. Using monthly data from 1975 to 2025, we document three findings. First, the QBVAR improves median forecasts by 2-5\% relative to Bayesian VARs, demonstrating that quantile-specific dynamics matter even for point prediction. Second, uncertainty and financial condition variables strongly predict downside risk, with left-tail forecast improvements of 10-25\% that intensify during crisis episodes. Third, right-tail forecasting remains difficult; stochastic volatility models dominate for upside risk, though forecast combinations that include the QBVAR recover these losses. The results show that modeling the conditional distribution yields substantial gains for tail risk assessment, particularly during major oil market disruptions.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们开发了一种分位数贝叶斯向量自回归（Quantile Bayesian Vector Autoregression, QBVAR）模型，用于预测条件分布不同分位数下的实际油价。该模型允许预测因子效应在不同分位数间存在差异，从而捕捉到以标准均值为中心的方法所忽略的不对称性。利用1975年至2025年的月度数据，我们得出了三个主要发现：首先，与传统的贝叶斯向量自回归（Bayesian VAR）模型相比，QBVAR模型在中位数预测上的准确率提高了2%至5%，这表明即使在进行点预测时，分位数特定的动态特征也具有重要意义；其次，不确定性因素和金融状况变量能够有效预测下行风险，其预测效果在危机期间尤为显著（下行风险预测的准确率提升了10%至25%）；最后，上行风险的预测仍然具有挑战性，尽管包含QBVAR模型的预测组合能够部分弥补这一不足。研究结果表明，对条件分布进行建模能够显著提升尾部风险的评估能力，尤其是在石油市场发生重大波动时。。研究方法：回归分析、贝叶斯方法、向量自回归、随机过程。

papers.title: Emulating Stepped-Wedge Cluster Randomized Trials to Evaluate Health Policies and Interventions
papers.abstract: Both cluster randomized trials and quasi-experimental designs are used to evaluate the impact of health and social policies and interventions. Stepped-wedge cluster randomized trials randomize a staggered adoption approach, while recent difference-in-differences methods allow analysis of non-randomized settings where similar policies are adopted at different time points. These approaches have become common, but the sheer variety of methods for analyzing observational studies with staggered adoption makes it challenging to clearly design and report such studies. We propose that observational and quasi-experimental study investigators can address these challenges by emulating stepped-wedge cluster randomized trials in the target trial emulation framework. The conceptual framework and reporting standards of trial emulation will encourage consideration of key features of these designs, such as policy heterogeneity and time-varying effects, and clear reporting of the estimand and assumptions. It also highlights areas where those interested in randomized trials and quasi-experimental designs can benefit from one another's experience by bringing insights across disciplines. Questions of treatment effect heterogeneity, power, spillovers, and anticipation effects, among others, are common to both fields and can benefit from cross-pollination. This article also demonstrates how trial emulation can identify settings that are not well-served by either approach, thereby avoiding studies unlikely to generate high-quality causal evidence. Finally, it informs the bias-variance-generalizability trade-off that arises with design and analysis choices made in these settings, supporting better evidence generation and interpretation in settings where important questions can be answered.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】集群随机试验和准实验设计都被用于评估健康与社会政策及干预措施的影响。阶梯式楔形集群随机试验采用分阶段实施的政策推广方法；而近年发展的差异-差异（difference-in-differences）方法则能够分析那些在不同时间点实施相似政策的非随机化环境。尽管这些方法已变得较为普遍，但由于用于分析分阶段实施政策的观察性研究的方法种类繁多，因此明确设计并报告此类研究仍颇具挑战性。我们建议观察性研究和准实验研究的设计者可以通过在目标试验模拟框架中模仿阶梯式楔形集群随机试验来应对这些挑战。该框架及报告标准有助于研究者充分考虑这些研究设计的关键特征（如政策异质性和时变效应），并清晰地说明估计量及其假设。同时，这种方法还能促进不同领域研究者之间的经验交流，使那些对随机试验和准实验设计感兴趣的人能够从中受益。治疗效果异质性、统计功效、溢出效应以及预期效应等问题在两个领域中都很常见，通过跨学科的交流可以更好地解决这些问题。本文还展示了如何利用试验模拟方法识别那些无法通过任一现有方法有效研究的情境，从而避免那些难以产生高质量因果证据的研究。最后，本文探讨了在这些设计选择中可能出现的偏差-方差-泛化...。研究方法：双重差分、实验方法、随机实验。

papers.title: Causal Graphs for Conditional Parallel Trends
papers.abstract: Difference-in-Differences (DiD) is a widely used research design that often relies on a conditional parallel trends (CPT) assumption. In contrast to settings with unconfoundedness, where causal graphs provide powerful frameworks for reasoning about valid conditioning variables, general-purpose graphical tools for CPT are missing. We introduce transformed Single World Intervention Graphs (SWIGs), the $Δ$-SWIGs, and prove that they enable us to read off conditional independencies via $d$-separation that imply CPT. Using $Δ$-SWIGs, we study valid conditioning strategies for DiD in complex settings with multiple periods and time-varying covariates. We show that when time-varying covariates affect the outcome, controlling for post-treatment variables is required for identification. However, even when such controls are included, pre-treatment parallel trends are only informative about a subset of the assumptions required for unbiased post-treatment effects, highlighting the limitations of purely empirical justifications of CPT.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】差异中的差异（Difference-in-Differences, DiD）是一种广泛使用的研究设计方法，该方法通常依赖于“条件平行趋势”（Conditional Parallel Trends, CPT）的假设。与不存在混杂因素的情况不同，在后者中因果图为推断有效的条件变量提供了有力的分析框架；然而，目前还缺乏适用于CPT的通用图形工具。我们提出了改进型的“单一世界干预图”（Transformed Single World Intervention Graphs, SWIGs），即$Δ$-SWIGs，并证明了这些图形工具能够通过$d$-分离（d-separation）来揭示条件独立性，从而间接支持CPT假设。利用$Δ$-SWIGs，我们研究了在包含多个时期和时变协变量的复杂环境中进行DiD分析时的有效条件策略。研究发现，当时变协变量对结果产生影响时，必须控制处理后的变量才能准确识别因果关系。然而，即便纳入了这些控制变量，处理前的平行趋势也只能提供部分关于无偏处理后效应所需假设的信息，这凸显了仅依靠实证方法来验证CPT假设的局限性。。研究方法：双重差分。

papers.title: A Bayes-Factor-Guided Approach to Post-Double Selection with Bootstrapped Multiple Imputation
papers.abstract: When variable selection methods are applied to bootstrapped and multiply imputed datasets, the set of selected variables typically varies across iterations. Aggregating results via the union rule can lead to overly dense models. We propose a sequential evidence aggregation procedure that models detection outcomes across perturbation iterations as Bernoulli trials and accumulates evidence for variable relevance through a likelihood-ratio process admitting an approximate Bayes-factor interpretation. The procedure provides both a variable inclusion criterion and a stopping rule that eliminates the need to fix the number of bootstrap-imputation iterations ex ante. A Monte Carlo study across 126 scenarios and an empirical illustration demonstrate the method's performance relative to existing aggregation approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：当变量选择方法应用于自助法和多重插补生成的数据集时，所选变量集在各次迭代中通常存在差异，使用并集规则聚合结果往往会导致模型过于密集。

🔬 研究方法：提出了一种顺序证据聚合程序，将扰动迭代中的检测结果建模为伯努利试验，并通过似然比过程累积证据，从而提供变量包含准则和停止规则。

📊 核心发现：该方法无需预先固定自助法-插补迭代的数量，且在126个场景的蒙特卡洛研究和实证示例中，其性能优于现有的聚合方法。

💡 应用价值：该方法解决了使用并集规则导致模型过密的问题，为处理多重插补和自助法数据提供了更高效的变量选择方案。

papers.title: Distributional Change in Ordinal Data with Missing Observations: Minimal Mobility and Partial Identification
papers.abstract: Empirical analyses often compare distributions of ordinal variables across groups or over time using repeated cross-sectional data, where only marginal distributions are observed and missing data are pervasive. As a result, the joint distribution linking these marginals is not identified, making it difficult to assess how observed differences arise. This paper studies how distributional change can be measured and interpreted under such limited information. I show that the $L_1$ distance between cumulative distribution functions admits an optimal transport representation as the minimal reallocation of probability mass across ordered categories. This representation delivers both a scalar measure of discrepancy and a structured description of how distributional change must occur, which I refer to as minimal-mobility configurations. To address missing data, I adopt a partial identification approach and construct sharp bounds on the marginal distributions. These bounds induce identified sets for both the discrepancy measure and the associated minimal-mobility configurations, providing inference that is robust to nonresponse and a transparent basis for assessing sensitivity to missing data. An empirical illustration using data from the \emph{Arab Barometer} demonstrates how the framework can be used in practice to quantify and interpret distributional change under limited information.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】实证分析通常利用重复横截面数据来比较不同群体或不同时间点上序数变量的分布情况，但这类研究中仅能观察到变量的边缘分布（即每个类别中观测值的频率分布），且缺失数据较为普遍。因此，无法确定这些边缘分布之间的联合分布关系，从而难以解释观测到的差异是如何产生的。本文探讨了在信息有限的情况下如何衡量和解释分布变化。研究发现，累积分布函数之间的$L_1$距离可以通过概率质量在有序类别间的最小重新分配来表示；这种表示方法既能提供差异的量化度量，也能清晰地说明分布变化应如何发生（我将这种分布变化方式称为“最小流动性配置”）。为了解决缺失数据问题，本文采用了部分识别方法，并对边缘分布进行了精确的界定。这些界定为差异度量及相关的最小流动性配置提供了明确的参考范围，使得推断结果对样本缺失具有较好的鲁棒性，同时也为评估数据缺失对分析结果的影响提供了透明的依据。通过使用《阿拉伯晴雨表》（Arab Barometer）的数据进行的实证研究，展示了该框架在实践中如何用于在信息有限的情况下量化和解释分布变化。。研究方法：横截面分析。
